about: Unregistered on-screen English already in the page code when the build check began (translation system, stage 4; SiteTranslation/system/HANDOFF.md). The build check (english_build_check.py) fails only on text beyond this.
code: text -> how many times the check's net finds it. reading: English the stage 3 browser reading traced to page code that the net does not see.

It may only shrink: run `python content/translation/english_build_check.py --shrink` after registering text. Growth is refused unless a new entry in widenings records the reason and the exact number added.
